name: Glasgow Favourites Evening I 2024

venue.name: Learning and Teaching Building, Strathclyde University

information: ## Please read the [Favourites Competition Format tab]( https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GlasgowFavEveningI2024#48333-favourites-competition-format) before registering. You are only able to register for a few of the events available at this competition. ##### Please be aware that this is an evening competition and does not begin until 5:20pm ### This competition will run in 2 groups. You will compete in one group and run, judge, or scramble for the other group. You MUST be present for the entirety of both groups (i.e. 5:20pm - 8:30pm) otherwise you will not be allowed to compete. Please make sure to read all the information in the tabs above. [![Imgur](https://i.imgur.com/OXOffhf.png)](https://www.ukca.org/)
